name: canon-recall
description: LIVE: this suite asks the production store, not the fixture corpus (no throwaway database). Forty-five concepts — the twenty-five of the Canon (haskell-kb/notes/concepts) and the twenty of the Theory (theory-kb/notes/category-theory) — each asked twice: once plainly (the -en ids) and once paraphrased (the -p ids), so the suite also measures phrasing robustness. Every tracked file is English-only (the owner's order of 26/11, extended to suite files the same evening: the first hours' Spanish twins are now the paraphrase half); the Spanish way of asking is covered by ad-hoc probes, never a shipped file. The concept's own note must show up in the top 5; recall@1 and MRR say how often it comes FIRST. History: born 26/11 with the English-corpus law; the same day the store went to zero Spanish documents and the curated vote (one extra first-place vote for a -kb/notes/ uri) lifted the first-place rate from 29/45 (plain) to 41/45.
